name: skillswap-backend
description: SkillSwap Hub Backend - Node.js + Express + MongoDB

scripts.clear: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const mongoose = require('mongoose'); const User = require('./models/User'); const Skill = require('./models/Skill'); mongoose.connect(process.env.MONGO_URI).then(async () => { await User.deleteMany({}); await Skill.deleteMany({}); console.log('Database cleared!'); await mongoose.disconnect(); }).catch(console.error);"
